name: All-Text Manifesto
tagline: Near-black page, heavy white serif statements with one red emphasised phrase, grey reading text and a thin Inter footer, no images at all (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Near-black background, off-white type, grey paragraphs and a single signal red for the emphasised phrase.

typography.style: Extra-bold serif statements at large size, regular serif body with generous leading and a small letter-spaced Inter footer.

best_for: Talks built from sentences rather than visuals: values, principles and one-idea statements that should land hard. Works for internal culture and conviction-driven pitches.
avoid_for: Data-heavy reports that need charts or tables.
